description: Defines the 'Lesson' class representing a micro-lesson item with serialization methods and copy functionality.

classes.name: Lesson
classes.description: Represents a micro-lesson item with properties such as id, title, duration, summary, progress, and sections. Includes methods for JSON serialization and copying with modified progress.

methods.name: Lesson.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Lesson instance from a JSON map, parsing and assigning fields appropriately.

methods.name: Lesson.toJson
methods.description: Converts the Lesson instance into a JSON map.

methods.name: Lesson.copyWith
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Lesson with optional modified properties, such as progress.
